name: macrosona-capture-claude
description: Search Macrosona memory and save explicitly approved notes from Claude.

interface.shortDescription: Use Macrosona as long-term memory in Claude.
interface.longDescription: Searches your brain-scoped Macrosona before answers that depend on prior context and saves concise notes only when you explicitly ask. One OAuth connection enables both capabilities.
